corrections.original_text: Il divieto di fermata e sosta riguarda il dosso, sia sul lato in salita sia su quello in discesa.
corrections.revised_text: Sul dosso la visibilità è limitata e un veicolo fermo può essere visto troppo tardi. Per questo la fermata e la sosta sono vietate sul dosso, sia in salita sia in discesa.
corrections.original_finding: The text merely restates that stopping and parking are forbidden on both sides of the crest; it provides no explanation of why, contrary to the teaching-content requirement. Explain the limited visibility and resulting hazard, while retaining the rule in Codice della strada art. 158(1)(c).
corrections.resolution: Revised explanation adds the limited-visibility hazard and retains the prohibition; independent re-review accepted the revision.

corrections.original_text: Sul dosso è vietata anche la sosta nel tratto in salita, non solo in quello in discesa.
corrections.revised_text: La sosta è vietata anche sul tratto in salita del dosso: la visibilità limitata può impedire agli altri conducenti di vedere il veicolo fermo in tempo.
corrections.original_finding: The text repeats the ban on parking on the uphill side without explaining why. Explain the crest visibility hazard and the application of the prohibition to the crest; retain the printed FALSO.
corrections.resolution: Revised explanation adds the limited-visibility hazard and retains the prohibition; independent re-review accepted the revision.

corrections.original_text: Stopping and parking are prohibited on the crest, on both its uphill and downhill sides.
corrections.revised_text: Visibility is limited at a crest, so a stopped vehicle may be seen too late. Stopping and parking are prohibited on the crest, both uphill and downhill.
corrections.original_finding: The text merely restates that stopping and parking are forbidden on both sides of the crest; it provides no explanation of why, contrary to the teaching-content requirement. Explain the limited visibility and resulting hazard, while retaining the rule in Codice della strada art. 158(1)(c).
corrections.resolution: Revised explanation adds the limited-visibility hazard and retains the prohibition; independent re-review accepted the revision.

corrections.original_text: Parking is prohibited on the crest, including its uphill section, not just its downhill side.
corrections.revised_text: Parking is also prohibited on the uphill section of the crest: limited visibility may prevent other drivers from seeing the parked vehicle in time.
corrections.original_finding: The text repeats the ban on parking on the uphill side without explaining why. Explain the crest visibility hazard and the application of the prohibition to the crest; retain the printed FALSO.
corrections.resolution: Revised explanation adds the limited-visibility hazard and retains the prohibition; independent re-review accepted the revision.

corrections.original_text: En el cambio de rasante están prohibidos tanto detenerse como estacionarse, tanto en la subida como en la bajada.
corrections.revised_text: En el cambio de rasante la visibilidad es limitada y un vehículo detenido puede verse demasiado tarde. Por eso se prohíben la detención y el estacionamiento tanto en la subida como en la bajada del cambio de rasante.

corrections.original_text: Está prohibido estacionarse en el cambio de rasante, incluido el tramo de subida, no solo el de bajada.
corrections.revised_text: También está prohibido estacionarse en el tramo de subida del cambio de rasante: la visibilidad limitada puede impedir que otros conductores vean el vehículo estacionado a tiempo.
